scope: ObjC ScreenCaptureKit helper and development builder
Bounded Node/Python IPC and native screenshot file/coordinate semantics
ACC dynamic tools/list, direct stale calls, status diagnostics and host tool directory
Runtime capability and global/session desktop policy integration
New capture contract/live/LaunchServices tests and affected prior tests

findings.finding: Python synchronous stdin write preceded request deadline and could block on a stalled reader
findings.resolution: Nonblocking selector-driven input shares the request deadline

findings.finding: Mac screenshot could consume and delete an unrelated pre-existing Windows vision sidecar and report mismatched coordinate scale
findings.resolution: Mac entry explicitly embeds its own PNG and leaves unrelated sidecars intact

findings.finding: Window capture direct save could truncate an existing destination on write failure
findings.resolution: Reused office_io.atomic_save and verified original bytes survive injected save failure

findings.finding: Completed display capture did not revalidate display identity/layout/backing scale
findings.resolution: Capture compares active display metadata against its initial snapshot before returning pixels
findings.verificationLimit: The actual mid-capture physical layout-change race has no real hardware execution evidence

findings.finding: Malformed finite geometry and coordinate-space validation were incomplete
findings.resolution: Node and Python reject invalid geometry before writing or reporting mapped coordinates

findings.finding: Mac native screenshot ignored the existing timeoutMs input
findings.resolution: Dispatch forwards a bounded timeout into IPC, with cancellation and no-write regressions

findings.finding: Node and Python readiness differed for a granted state with no monitors
findings.resolution: Both require an unlocked authorized state with nonempty monitor metadata

findings.finding: New shell-based Mac IPC smoke cases were discoverable by Windows default smoke runner
findings.resolution: NativeIPC and CaptureTools explicitly skip outside darwin

findings.finding: Pure geometry test_plan unnecessarily initialized NSApplication before protocol parsing, causing first-launch timeouts
findings.resolution: Pure planner executes before NSApplication initialization and completion uses an independent lock; original 3000ms planner timeout is preserved

findings.finding: Minimize fixture lacked the Miniaturizable style and reported command dispatch before the corresponding native state transition
findings.resolution: Added the supported style and waits for DidMiniaturize/DidDeminiaturize notifications; original failure assertions remain
